landing.footerBuiltOn: Built on Cloudflare Workers · Vercel AI SDK · opencode.ai — thank you to our partners.
landing.chartAria: Sample chart comparing response rates of two groups
landing.subtitle: Heurion rebuilds medical AI with a dual-plane architecture: a Control Plane of traceable, stale-propagating DAG clinical memory, and an Execution Plane that generates DOCX, PPTX and statistical figures in an isolated sandbox.
landing.painQuote: “Before every follow-up, doctors re-paste years of labs, mutations and imaging.”
landing.desc: Every session starts from scratch. Before a follow-up or summary, doctors must re-paste years of labs, mutations, and imaging.
landing.desc2: Generated summaries look polished, but doctors cannot trust them: metrics may be invented, and sources cannot be traced.
landing.desc3: "Clean this follow-up data and plot a KM curve." Generic AI replies: "Sorry, I am a language model and cannot generate charts."
landing.dualPlaneSubtitle: No implementation details required: Heurion pairs a brain with persistent clinical memory and an execution engine that delivers results inside an isolated sandbox.
landing.desc4: Tell the AI to log in, query, and collect web information (Agent Browser). Also powers regression testing that simulates real user journeys.
landing.desc5: Upload lab reports, imaging snapshots, or notes and the AI interprets them directly (vision models; OCR fallback with explicit sourcing).
landing.desc6: Statistical charts (chart), 3D bioscience scenes (bioscene), and web operations (browser-agent) install on demand — the core stays lean.
landing.figDesc: Deliver publication-ready figures: error bars, CIs, p-values and sample sizes in journal style.
landing.figCaption: Figure 1. Treatment response rates by group; error bars denote 95% CIs; two-sided t-test.
landing.figWarn: Sample data for style demonstration only — not real study results
landing.complianceIntro: Heurion is a clinical research assistance tool. It does not provide diagnoses or treatment decisions — every AI output must be reviewed and confirmed by a licensed physician.
landing.desc7: AI content is reference-only, never a basis for clinical decisions.
landing.desc8: On-premise deployment; sandbox isolated from core records.
landing.desc9: An immutable EventLog records every access and generation.
landing.complianceFootnote: * Heurion is not a medical device and is not intended for diagnosis, treatment, or prognosis. Evaluate against your institution\u2019s regulations before deployment.
landing.partnersIntro: Heurion grows with clinicians and medical data ecosystems — built for real-world care.
landing.techLine: Built on Cloudflare Workers · Vercel AI SDK · GitHub open source — and every developer contributing to open source and health informatics.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Start free or self-host the full platform on your own servers.
landing.userMsg: Clean the 2024 follow-up data, plot KM curves, and export a DOCX report
landing.staleDesc: Underlying data changed → 2 reports auto-marked stale
landing.label: Data stays on-prem

security.title: Security & isolation architecture
security.subtitle: Heurion was designed from the ground up with clinical data privacy, auditability, and least privilege in mind.
security.planeControlDesc: Hosts authentication, patients, research, the knowledge base, and plugin management; plugins cannot reach core data directly.
security.planeExecutionDesc: Hosts report rendering, the plugin sandbox, and file delivery; isolated from core data.
security.principalTenantDesc: Each user's event log, facts, knowledge, and files are stored in an isolated workspace.
security.principalRbacDesc: Regular users and admins see different sidebar entries and API permissions.
security.principalAuditDesc: An immutable EventLog records every chat, file generation, and fact change, and supports export.
security.principalLeastPrivilegeDesc: Plugins and automated tasks have only the minimum access needed to complete their work.
security.contextBody: When a conversation is linked to a specific patient, the system forcibly appends age, sex, chief complaint, recent files, and other context to the prompt. This reduces the risk of the model "forgetting" the patient and giving generic advice.
security.regPiplMechanisms: Minimal-collection (only task-required fields); on-premise data residency; user export & deletion
security.regHipaaMechanisms: Tenant-level data isolation; immutable audit log (EventLog) of access & generation; RBAC; TLS in transit
security.regGdprMechanisms: Data-subject export/erasure; configurable log retention; minimization principle
security.regClassificationMechanisms: Sensitive fields (diagnosis, genetics, imaging) classified by use; research sandbox physically isolated from core records
security.selfHostBody: Deploy fully in a private cloud or on-premises so sensitive data never leaves your environment; all features run without external dependencies.
security.ctaTitle: Review the open-source code and security notes

memory.title: Four-layer memory + one projection
memory.subtitle: Heurion does not feed the whole chat history into the model. It distills raw inputs into increasingly abstract memory layers and projects only the most relevant fragments before each turn.
memory.layerRawDesc: User messages, uploaded files, assistant replies, and confirmations are appended to an immutable event log.
memory.layerFactsDesc: Auto-extracted every 5 turns with category, importance, sourceType, and patientHash.
memory.layerKnowledgeDesc: When ≥3 related facts accumulate, they are synthesized into versioned summaries.
memory.layerPersonaDesc: A dynamic system identity generated before each chat from all facts and knowledge.
memory.projectionItem1: Persona: who you are, what you care about, and how you prefer to communicate
memory.projectionItem2: Current patient context (highest priority, never forgotten)
memory.projectionItem4: Recent session episode summaries (compressed long-term history)
memory.projectionItem6: Skills: validated, reusable strategies and tools
memory.decayBody: A fact with importance=5 decays to ~12% attention after 7 days; importance=1 facts nearly drop out. Old knowledge is not deleted — it just yields to newer, more relevant content.
memory.ctaBody: Open the Memory Graph inside the app to visually explore links between patients, facts, and knowledge.
memory.projectionIntro: Projection is not simple concatenation. It composes different memory layers into the system prompt by priority and attention weight.
memory.coverageLow: Coverage below threshold — ask the assistant to summarize the knowledge base or synthesize a summary from uncovered facts (e.g. "{{sample}}")

sidecar.subtitle: Turn a clinical discussion into a deliverable document, table, or chart with one sentence. The report assistant renders independently in the execution plane without blocking the chat stream.
sidecar.capabilityBody: If a user merely asks "Can you create a PPT?", the report assistant returns available formats and examples instead of generating an empty file.
sidecar.kbBody: When generating a file, the report assistant also emits a knowledgePayload. The chat download card offers an "Add to knowledge base" option to turn the document into Facts or Summaries.
sidecar.title: Smart Report Assistant: from chat to document
sidecar.desc: Case summaries, discharge summaries, protocols, follow-up notes
sidecar.desc2: Academic presentation slides with auto-paging and heading hierarchy
sidecar.desc4: KM survival curves, bar charts, line charts, forest plots
sidecar.desc5: The Query Router detects report-generation requests like "generate / create / export" so normal chat is not mis-triggered.
sidecar.desc6: Jobs complete file generation and delivery asynchronously in an isolated environment.
sidecar.desc7: The fileId is persisted to the EventLog, so the download link can be recovered after a page refresh.
sidecar.ctaBody: Log in, open Chat, and type "Generate a PPTX on NSCLC immunotherapy advances".
sidecar.item2: "Generate a PPTX reviewing EGFR-TKI resistance mechanisms, including research progress and clinical implications."

knowledgeLanding.subtitle: Heurion turns facts from chat and files into manageable, searchable, and completable knowledge. Summaries record source fact versions; fact changes propagate; the knowledge base grows and corrects itself.
knowledgeLanding.evolveBody: The Evolution Engine runs outside the chat path: it auto-extracts facts, deduplicates and links them, tries to answer gaps, and synthesizes an summary when enough related facts accumulate. Summaries record source fact versions, and fact changes automatically mark dependent summaries stale via Curation.
knowledgeLanding.gapBody: When a user asks something with no matching facts, the system creates a Gap. Instead of silently hallucinating, it records "I don\'t know" and waits for you to answer, search, or validate later.
knowledgeLanding.title: Evolving knowledge base
knowledgeLanding.desc: Synthesis summaries from facts; version history, stale badges, regenerate, and impact views.
knowledgeLanding.desc2: Structured memory snippets; edits/deletes cascade to dependent summaries, with version history and impact analysis.
knowledgeLanding.desc3: Unanswered questions identified by the system; answer with a fact or summary, ignore, or close in bulk.
knowledgeLanding.desc4: Enabled or pending plugins and tools, with toggles and description management.
knowledgeLanding.desc5: Uploaded files and report-assistant outputs stored with tenant isolation; deleting a file cascades to its derived facts.
knowledgeLanding.desc6: Each tab has independent keyword filtering to locate content quickly.
knowledgeLanding.desc7: Browse version chains for facts and summaries; regenerate stale summaries in one click.
knowledgeLanding.desc8: Select multiple items and delete them in one go.
knowledgeLanding.desc9: Edit facts inline; preview which summaries will be affected before saving.
knowledgeLanding.evolveTitle: Async evolution from Facts to Summaries
knowledgeLanding.gapTitle: Knowledge Gap: make the unknown visible
knowledgeLanding.ctaBody: Log in and open Memory & Knowledge to see your Summaries, Facts, and Gaps.
